text: The portal gives each partner exactly one view: their own warranty claims, and nothing else.
The claims-list widget runs a plain GlideRecord query -- no partner filter in the script at all.
That's deliberate. The row-level ACL from the last lesson does the filtering, the same way it protects every native screen.
Dmitri logs in as two different partner accounts side by side and confirms each only ever sees their own claims.
Next: Flow Designer routes every new claim to the right internal reviewer automatically.
